correctness.rationale: C: Orthogonal spectral decomposition reduces the 2n Laplacian to the 2x2 symmetric block [[alpha+s,-s],[-s,s]] over each core E_alpha. Its lambda_-<s and lambda_+>=2s are strictly ordered, with disjoint lower/upper spectral ranges, so the PBH test can sum nullity across lifted eigenspaces with multiplicities unchanged. Lower output factor 1+beta rho_- is strictly positive; upper factor vanishes exactly at b_s(alpha), giving the exact rank formula and full-state criterion. For nonnegative gains β=1 kills the upper constant mode at alpha=0. At most one erasure among all pairwise distinct β_i, and connectedness with positive existing edge weight rules out an eigenvector supported on one vertex, proving universal all-modules recovery. Independent exact SymPy rank tests on three-path core s=2 gave ranks 5 for gains (1,1,1) and (2,2,2), rank 6 for (1/2,1/2,1/2) and (1,2,3). The statement excludes heterogeneous s and noisy conditioning.

final_claim: For connected weighted undirected core Laplacian L and identical leaf conductance s>0, scalar module measurements u_i+beta_i v_i (beta_i>=0) have unobservable dimension sum_alpha (2m_alpha-r_alpha(S)-r_alpha(S_alpha)), where S_alpha deletes sensors with gain beta_i=(alpha+sqrt(alpha²+4s²))/(2s). Every module measured with pairwise distinct nonnegative gains guarantees observability for all such bases.
